cues.text: The Blender Foundation Presents logo appears centered on a dark, snowy, mountainous landscape with blurred, shadowy rock formations in the foreground.
Snow-covered mountains loom, with a distant, icy structure visible.
A figure in a hooded, brown outfit stands on snow, gripping a long, curved staff, with misty, snow-capped mountains looming behind them.
A hooded figure lunges forward.
Hooded figure extends hand forward.
A bald man in dark armor draws a knife.
Bald man in dark armor raises a knife, gripping a staff as a red-haired figure bends forward in the snow.
Red-haired figure lies motionless in snow, knife resting beside them, hand clutching coat.
Snow-covered mountains loom over a distant, warmly lit shelter.
A red-haired figure stands in the snow, holding a staff, with towering, snow-laden mountains looming in the misty background.
Red-haired figure looks down.
Red-haired figure stands in rubble-strewn alley.
A red-haired figure grips a heavy, dark object, her arm extended as she stands in a sunlit, rubble-strewn alley with weathered buildings behind her.
Red-haired figure stands on a broken roof, gripping a knife.
Red-haired figure lowers knife.
Red-haired figure looks up with wide eyes, her mouth slightly open.
A small, scaled creature with wide eyes lies on a tiled roof, its body stained with blood, as a human hand reaches down toward it.
Red-haired figure gently holds the small scaled creature, her gaze soft as a gloved hand rests near its head.
Red-haired figure stands in alleyway, apples scattered at her feet.
Red-haired figure stands in alleyway, facing another person whose back is to camera.
Red-haired figure stares forward, her expression startled, as a gloved hand hovers near her head.
Red-haired figure stands atop ruins.
Red-haired figure stands atop ruins, hands clasped, smiling at camera.
Red-haired figure stands atop ruins as a large dragon flies past.
A small, horned dragon with open mouth flies past a reaching hand.
Red-haired figure stands atop ruins, eyes wide, mouth agape, revealing a surprised expression.
A blur of motion shows the red-haired figure’s boots pounding across the dusty ground as they sprint away from the ruins.
A red-haired figure crouches behind bamboo stalks.
A figure with dark hair and a staff turns.
The red-haired figure lies motionless in the snow, their head and staff visible above the white surface, shadows cast behind them.
The red-haired figure stands in a snowy, jagged landscape, their fur-lined coat and staff visible, with mist swirling around them.
The red-haired figure, previously lying still, now sits upright in a dimly lit, shadowed interior, their shoulder and staff visible as light catches their cheek.
A small, dark figure stands on a rocky ledge within a vast, shadowy cave, silhouetted against a bright, full moon visible through the cavern’s arched opening.
A large, spiky, armored creature lies motionless on rocky ground within a dark, cavernous space, its form partially obscured by shadow and stone.
A small, dark figure approaches the sleeping dragon.
The small figure ignites the dragon’s head with a bright, fiery explosion.
The dragon’s head erupts in bright flame as the small figure retreats, leaving glowing embers and smoke rising from the cavern floor.
The red-haired figure draws a spear from the ground.
The red-haired figure leaps forward, spear drawn, as the dragon’s head explodes in fiery light, sending embers and smoke swirling through the cavern.
The dragon lies motionless on the dark cavern floor, its body still.
The red-haired figure stands in the dark cavern, gripping the spear, her expression one of stunned stillness after the dragon’s defeat.
The dragon lies motionless on the dark cavern floor, its scaled body still, with glowing red eyes and jagged teeth visible in the dim light.
The red-haired figure stands still.
The dragon’s head rests motionless on the cavern floor, its textured scales and glowing red eye visible in the dim light, with faint particles drifting through the air.
A lone figure sits atop a rugged hill, dwarfed by a colossal, gnarled tree root system in the foreground, with misty, sunlit mountains receding into the hazy horizon.
The red-haired figure’s eyes close as they remain still, their shoulder bearing a fresh wound.
The camera focuses on a vast, uneven expanse of rough, cracked earth with deep grooves and scattered pebbles under dim, muted lighting.
